_doc: The Creation Artifact (see docs/DESIGN.md). starting_lives: lives a new character has. max_lives: cap on stored lives. anchor_slots: realm id -> anchors that can be bound once the player reaches that realm (the highest reached realm listed applies). start_anchor: anchor id bound automatically for a new character. recharge: buying a life costs round(base_cost * cost_growth ^ lives bought so far) spirit stones. respawn: on a violent death with a life left, the player respawns at their most recently bound anchor (the start region if none; the respawn screen then lets them awaken at any other bound anchor instead), losing qi_loss_fraction of current qi while days pass. Anchors are places in data/regions.json with an 'anchor_id' (globally unique). energy (ART-002): feeding the artifact gives stone_energy per spirit stone, and floor(price * item_energy_per_price) per other item (price-0 items cannot be fed); energy is capped at max_energy and spent to unlock functions. functions: sealed powers the player unlocks (ArtifactFunctions): {id (must be a function the code implements: storage), name, description, unlock: {realm (optional realm id reached), energy (spent on unlocking), flag (optional world flag that must be set)}, plus per-function fields: storage has storage_slots (distinct item stacks the storage space holds)}. intro_event (optional, ART-006b): a dialogue id (data/dialogue/, not bound to an NPC; nodes set their own speaker) played once when a new character starts; loaded saves never play it.

functions.name: Storage Space
functions.description: A pocket of folded space opens inside the artifact. Whatever you keep there stays with your soul, even through death.
